ex.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.
Their call therein will be, "Exalted are You, O Allāh," and their greeting therein will be, "Peace." And the last of their call will be, "Praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds!"
And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,
And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.
A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
Why do the rabbis and religious scholars not forbid them from saying what is sinful and devouring what is unlawful? How wretched is what they have been practicing.

Prohibited to you [for marriage] are your mothers, your daughters, your sisters, your father's sisters, your mother's sisters, your brother's daughters, your sister's daughters, your [milk] mothers who nursed you, your sisters through nursing, your wives' mothers, and your step-daughters under your guardianship [born] of your wives unto whom you have gone in. But if you have not gone in unto them, there is no sin upon you. And [also prohibited are] the wives of your sons who are from your [own] loins, and that you take [in marriage] two sisters simultaneously, except for what has already occurred. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

And how many a prophet [fought in battle and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allāh, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allāh loves the steadfast.
Those who believed and were fearing Allāh.
As guidance and good tidings for the believers
Indeed, those who purchase disbelief [in exchange] for faith - never will they harm Allāh at all, and for them is a painful punishment.
Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
[Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.
They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

[Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
I swear by the Day of Resurrection
The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
Guide us to the straight path -
Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
And establish prayer and give zakāh and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.
And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
[Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.

But those firm in knowledge among them and the believers believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you. And the establishers of prayer [especially] and the givers of zakāh and the believers in Allāh and the Last Day - those We will give a great reward.
But those who have disbelieved deny,
Say, "O disbelievers,
And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
[By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?
And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
In a clear Arabic language.

[We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses [i.e., laws] that you might use reason.

And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.
But all things We have enumerated in writing.
Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.
And We had already sent among them warners.
ʿAad denied the messengers
[Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.
Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.

[Hūd] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allāh has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."
[He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
Who will bring you every learned magician."
Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"

And for you is half of what your wives leave if they have no child. But if they have a child, for you is one fourth of what they leave, after any bequest they [may have] made or debt. And for them [i.e., the wives] is one fourth if you leave no child. But if you leave a child, then for them is an eighth of what you leave, after any bequest you [may have] made or debt. And if a man or woman leaves neither ascendants nor descendants but has a brother or a sister, then for each one of them is a sixth. But if they are more than two, they share a third, after any bequest which was made or debt, as long as there is no detriment [caused]. [This is] an ordinance from Allāh, and Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.

And Allāh presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a manager.
Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.

And not alike are the two seas [i.e., bodies of water]. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
About what they used to do.
But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."
Working [hard] and exhausted.
And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words [i.e., commands] and he fulfilled them. [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allāh] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."
[This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
And obey Allāh and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy.
It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."
Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows

And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves."
So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].
Then do you see of them any remains?
Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

O you who have believed, do not invalidate your charities with reminders [of it] or injury as does one who spends his wealth [only] to be seen by the people and does not believe in Allāh and the Last Day. His example is like that of a [large] smooth stone upon which is dust and is hit by a downpour that leaves it bare. They are unable [to keep] anything of what they have earned. And Allāh does not guide the disbelieving people.

And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed, I fear Allāh. And Allāh is severe in penalty."

So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars."
And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

Prescribed for you when death approaches [any] one of you if he leaves wealth [is that he should make] a bequest for the parents and near relatives according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous.

And if you are on a journey and cannot find a scribe, then a security deposit [should be] taken. And if one of you entrusts another, then let him who is entrusted discharge his trust [faithfully] and let him fear Allāh, his Lord. And do not conceal testimony, for whoever conceals it - his heart is indeed sinful, and Allāh is Knowing of what you do.
And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.
Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see?
Have you seen if he is upon guidance
[The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
[The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
Nor are the darknesses and the light,
These are the verses of Allāh. We recite them to you, [O Muḥammad], in truth; and Allāh wants no injustice to the worlds [i.e., His creatures].
And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.
The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
And they [i.e., the false deities] are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves.
And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]
The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
And whoever desires other than Islām as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.
And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers."
Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
[We revealed it] lest you say, "The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us, but we were of their study unaware,"
And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allāh is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muḥammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know.
The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
It is but a reminder to the worlds.
And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.
As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.
Is the male for you and for Him the female?
So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allāh that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?"
And Allāh will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."
And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

But if it is found that those two were guilty of sin [i.e., perjury], let two others stand in their place [who are] foremost [in claim] from those who have a lawful right. And let them swear by Allāh, "Our testimony is truer than their testimony, and we have not transgressed. Indeed, we would then be of the wrongdoers."
ʿAad denied the messengers
He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."
They [the accusers] said, "Then what would be its recompense if you should be liars?"
Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Aware.
And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
Indeed, those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.

Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
And Allāh has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He [i.e., Allāh] is but one God, so fear only Me."

And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allāh has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
Indeed, I have relied upon Allāh, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds it by its forelock [i.e., controls it]. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight.

This day [all] good foods have been made lawful, and the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you and your food is lawful for them. And [lawful in marriage are] chaste women from among the believers and chaste women from among those who were given the Scripture before you, when you have given them their due compensation, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse or taking [secret] lovers. And whoever denies the faith - his work has become worthless, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.
Who created and proportioned
Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
That is Allāh, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allāh and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allāh will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment.
Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
So fear Allāh and obey me.
And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allāh, to whom you will be gathered.
Those who say, 'Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire,' "
And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh
For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allāh any protector.
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
And Manāt, the third - the other one?
He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

And remember Allāh during [specific] numbered days. Then whoever hastens [his departure] in two days - there is no sin upon him; and whoever delays [until the third] - there is no sin upon him - for him who fears Allāh. And fear Allāh and know that unto Him you will be gathered.
And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."

And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, "O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors."

[Such believers are] the repentant, the worshippers, the praisers [of Allāh], the travelers [for His cause], those who bow and prostrate [in prayer], those who enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and those who observe the limits [set by] Allāh. And give good tidings to the believers.
And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

Had it been a near [i.e., easy] gain and a moderate trip, they [i.e., the hypocrites] would have followed you, but distant to them was the journey. And they will swear by Allāh, "If we were able, we would have gone forth with you," destroying themselves [through false oaths], and Allāh knows that indeed they are liars.

But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
And if they cease, then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
Degrees [of high position] from Him and forgiveness and mercy. And Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. And when the earthquake seized them, he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers.
And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.
But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
So from wherever you go out [for prayer, O Muḥammad], turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, and indeed, it is the truth from your Lord. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
But Allāh is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.
Woe to you, and woe!
And for all, We have made heirs to what is left by parents and relatives. And to those whom your oaths have bound [to you] - give them their share. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, a Witness.
[They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e., futility].
O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of Allāh and believe in him; He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
Their call therein will be, "Exalted are You, O Allāh," and their greeting therein will be, "Peace." And the last of their call will be, "Praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds!"
So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
[The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
[And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

And if you fear dissension between the two, send an arbitrator from his people and an arbitrator from her people. If they both desire reconciliation, Allāh will cause it between them. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Aware.
So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.
Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
And they requested decision [i.e., victory from Allāh], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.
Within gardens and springs
And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
From among the jinn and mankind."
Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

For each [religious following] is a [prayer] direction toward which it faces. So race to [all that is] good. Wherever you may be, Allāh will bring you forth [for judgement] all together. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allāh and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
And fruit of what they select
And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
Nor are the darknesses and the light,
Then if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so were messengers denied before you, who brought clear proofs and written ordinances and the enlightening Scripture.
As guidance and mercy for the doers of good
Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.
And spend in the way of Allāh and do not throw [yourselves] with your [own] hands into destruction [by refraining]. And do good; indeed, Allāh loves the doers of good.
And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
And denies the best [reward],

Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
"By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
Indeed they found their fathers astray.
He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
And preferred the life of the world,
And that it is He who causes death and gives life
He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.

And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet [in return] with one better than it or [at least] return it [in a like manner]. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, an Accountant.
They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.

O Messenger, let them not grieve you who hasten into disbelief – of those who say, "We believe" with their mouths, but their hearts believe not, and from among the Jews. [They are] avid listeners to falsehood, listening to another people who have not come to you. They distort words beyond their [proper] places [i.e., usages], saying, "If you are given this, take it; but if you are not given it, then beware." But he for whom Allāh intends fitnah - never will you possess [power to do] for him a thing against Allāh. Those are the ones for whom Allāh does not intend to purify their hearts. For them in this world is disgrace, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment.
Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
Cursed were those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel by the tongue of David and of Jesus, the son of Mary. That was because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.
Has He chosen daughters over sons?
They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

He said, "Indeed, I wish to wed you one of these, my two daughters, on [the condition] that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten, it will be [as a favor] from you. And I do not wish to put you in difficulty. You will find me, if Allāh wills, from among the righteous."
And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].
The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.
And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.
So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
Then he followed a way
We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

And if you brought to those who were given the Scripture every sign, they would not follow your qiblah. Nor will you be a follower of their qiblah. Nor would they be followers of one another's qiblah. So if you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, indeed, you would then be among the wrongdoers.

And [for] their saying, "Indeed, we have killed the Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary, the messenger of Allāh." And they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him; but [another] was made to resemble him to them. And indeed, those who differ over it are in doubt about it. They have no knowledge of it except the following of assumption. And they did not kill him, for certain.
And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"
And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
And fight in the cause of Allāh and know that Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

Battle has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allāh knows, while you know not.
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little."

Those messengers - some of them We caused to exceed others. Among them were those to whom Allāh spoke, and He raised some of them in degree. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs, and We supported him with the Pure Spirit [i.e., Gabriel]. If Allāh had willed, those [generations] succeeding them would not have fought each other after the clear proofs had come to them. But they differed, and some of them believed and some of them disbelieved. And if Allāh had willed, they would not have fought each other, but Allāh does what He intends.
Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.
And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.
When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, "You remained not but one day."

ex.gloss: then he assumed for her the likeness
ex.translation: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.
No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.
Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land.
They said, "Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."
Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."

Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."

[It was] so that Allāh may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allāh may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
[They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
And do not confer favor to acquire more
And increased therein the corruption.

Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
[Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.
Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
O you who have believed, fear Allāh as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims [in submission to Him].
So We said, "Strike him [i.e., the slain man] with part of it." Thus does Allāh bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.
And that it is He who causes death and gives life
And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers."
Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
And he showed him the greatest sign,
And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]
O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.

And say, "Do [as you will], for Allāh will see your deeds, and [so will] His Messenger and the believers. And you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do."
And recite to them the news of Abraham,
And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.

He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."

ex.gloss: And they ask you to inform
ex.translation: And they ask information of you, [O Muḥammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allāh]."
And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allāh while you witness [to their truth]?
[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out
Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

Indeed, Allāh is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allāh intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,
Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.
Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
They say, "Be Jews or Christians [so] you will be guided." Say, "Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists."
They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.
And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].
Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
He has sent down upon you, [O Muḥammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel
But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allāh will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.
And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
And among them are some who criticize you concerning the [distribution of] charities. If they are given from them, they approve; but if they are not given from them, at once they become angry.
And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
That is because Allāh would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
That is because Allāh would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
And the chargers at dawn,

Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... [Are its inhabitants] like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
And then there came to them that which they were promised?
And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."

And your Lord is the Forgiving, the possessor of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.
Effecter of what He intends.

And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
So when vision is dazzled
And see, for they are going to see.
There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord. So whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. And [say], "I am not a guardian over you."
It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
[Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].
And what struck you on the day the two armies met [at Uḥud] was by permission of Allāh that He might make evident the [true] believers
But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.
But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
Provided you with grazing livestock and children
"Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured." And excellent is the final home.
O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds [i.e., peoples].
In gardens of pleasure
And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
Only a saying [of] peace, peace.
Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
And whoever desires other than Islām as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.

There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.

You will find others who wish to obtain security from you and [to] obtain security from their people. Every time they are returned to [the influence of] disbelief, they fall back into it. So if they do not withdraw from you or offer you peace or restrain their hands, then seize them and kill them wherever you overtake them. And those - We have made for you against them a clear authorization.
And preferred the life of the world,
And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

And it is He who sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby the growth of all things. We produce from it greenery from which We produce grains arranged in layers. And from the palm trees - of its emerging fruit are clusters hanging low. And [We produce] gardens of grapevines and olives and pomegranates, similar yet varied. Look at [each of] its fruit when it yields and [at] its ripening. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
Then he approached and descended
[They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
To Allāh is your return, and He is over all things competent."
But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.
And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.
And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
And We had already sent among them warners.
Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
And whatever you spend of expenditures or make of vows - indeed, Allāh knows of it. And for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, [such as]
And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.

[David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
[Allāh] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
[Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
And wait; indeed, we are waiting."
So do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."
And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers.
Then do not obey the deniers.
It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
And to Allāh prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.
Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.

Indeed, aṣ-Ṣafā and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allāh. So whoever makes ḥajj [pilgrimage] to the House or performs ʿumrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allāh is Appreciative and Knowing.
And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
Say, "In the bounty of Allāh and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."
And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."
Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
Even if we should be decayed bones?"

The ones who have believed, emigrated and striven in the cause of Allāh with their wealth and their lives are greater in rank in the sight of Allāh. And it is those who are the attainers [of success].
He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
And the people of the city came rejoicing.
Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.
Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do.
Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding -
And enter among My [righteous] servants
And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger and transgresses His limits - He will put him into the Fire to abide eternally therein, and he will have a humiliating punishment.
He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.
They said, "O Moses, indeed within it is a people of tyrannical strength, and indeed, we will never enter it until they leave it; but if they leave it, then we will enter."

And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allāh, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
If they could find a refuge or some caves or any place to enter [and hide], they would turn to it while they run heedlessly.
And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers.
We [i.e., Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
That is only Satan who frightens [you] of his supporters. So fear them not, but fear Me, if you are [indeed] believers.

And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allāh from being mentioned [i.e., praised] in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment.
Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allāh great bounty.
And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
As guidance and good tidings for the believers

ex.gloss: and a bearer of glad tidings
ex.translation: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"
And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

And whenever a sūrah is revealed, there are among them [i.e., the hypocrites] those who say, "Which of you has this increased in faith?" As for those who believed, it has increased them in faith, while they are rejoicing.
That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allāh entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allāh? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.
So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

Say, "O Allāh, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings [of fire]. And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
As reward for what they used to do.

O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

Fight against those who do not believe in Allāh or in the Last Day and who do not consider unlawful what Allāh and His Messenger have made unlawful and who do not adopt the religion of truth [i.e., Islām] from those who were given the Scripture - [fight] until they give the jizyah willingly while they are humbled.
[By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?
No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.

It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -

O you who have believed, do not violate the rites of Allāh or [the sanctity of] the sacred month or [neglect the marking of] the sacrificial animals and garlanding [them] or [violate the safety of] those coming to the Sacred House seeking bounty from their Lord and [His] approval. But when you come out of iḥrām, then [you may] hunt. And do not let the hatred of a people for having obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām lead you to transgress. And cooperate in righteousness and piety, but do not cooperate in sin and aggression. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
But man desires to continue in sin.
They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself [i.e., embraced them] and said, "Enter Egypt, Allāh willing, safe [and secure]."
And made the day for livelihood
And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
